steps.content:
June ??, N.F. 115
Location: ??
A sandstorm chokes the path, forcing the traveler into a nest of sandworms—the creatures long dead, their burrow now a tomb turned shelter.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...! Cough, cough—

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...I passed out? How long has it been?

She rolls onto her stomach, pressing her ear to the ground. Breath held, mind sharpened to a blade's edge, she listens. Through the sandstorm, the heavy, rhythmic rumbling in the distance seems to have truly ceased.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Lost them... thank goodness...
Huff...

A warm breath tickles her ear. Sibilla shudders—her nerves scream jump, but her exhausted muscles refuse. She chokes on a gasp, still sprawled on the ground. Her traveling companion, pleased with the successful prank, breaks into giggles.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Oh, Jasmine. You almost scared me to death. When did you sneak up on me? You're as quiet as a cat.
The woman named Jasmine rises to her tiptoes and spins in a circle. Her tattered cloak flutters, lifting just enough to betray her graceful, nimble figure beneath.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Heh, I do wish I were a cat. Nine lives to spare, free to face whatever comes my way. Here, have some water.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: You've been out cold forever. Another hour and you'd have baked into proper human jerky.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Uh, is this really water...? Or...

The first time Sibilla accepted this flask was after they escaped a group of desert bandits. Jasmine killed her way through, then pressed the flask into Sibilla's hands with a smile. Water, she called it. But the stench—rusty and metallic—clings to Sibilla's memory to this day. She didn't dare to ask what kind of water it was back then, only to suffer nightmares for a week straight after drinking it.
But she has no choice but to drink. To continue her journey, she must steel her resolve.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Okay, that'll restore strength... restore strength... restore strength... Alright, drink it and I'll hit the road! *Gulp*

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Hmm...? The taste is different? It's sweet?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Oh, did you think that was blood? Silly, we haven't seen another soul for ages! Where would I even get extra blood? And honestly, I'd hate to traumatize you all over again.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: We still have a long way to go before we get you to the Great Expo. Can't have you losing that spark along the way.

Sibilla has never learned where Jasmine came from. Their paths crossed on a bandit ship, where Sibilla was kidnapped "cargo" and Jasmine seemed to be a hired blade working for the bandits, assigned to guard the cages holding the captives.

To survive, Sibilla tried her best to build rapport with this unpredictable girl, hoping to create a chance to escape. But when that day finally came, Sibilla was shocked to see Jasmine catch up to her. Just like that, Jasmine left her bandit "comrades" behind without a second glance, and Sibilla couldn't fathom why.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Because you share your food and water with me.

The desert bandits had apparently kept Jasmine for quite some time. When the two escaped, the bandits' rage burned hotter than the midday sun. Armed with rattling Gatling guns, they chased them all night without stopping.
Jasmine was treated as a prized fighter. At the very least, she shouldn't have lacked food or water.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Mmm... well, because that DisCity gala you mentioned sounds like fun. I want to go too.
The desert bandits had clearly set their sights on the Great Expo as well. They had been ramping up their attacks on Outland trade caravans traveling during this window of opportunity.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Those desert bandits have become scaredy cats these days. Won't even look at DisCity, and won't let me near it either, saying that I'd stir up trouble... Where's the fun in that?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: But you're different from them, Sibilla. I know you'll keep pushing forward without hesitation. If I follow you, I'll find my way. And I'll find what I'm looking for.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: So take me to DisCity! I've never been there before. Can't wait to have fun!
Yet her Disian is flawless, showing no trace of the common tongue spoken in Fraser and elsewhere. That's a distinction only those born within the city's walls ever truly master.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Oh, really? Hmm... Maybe I'm just a natural with languages?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Hold on, that's not it. It's my blades that speak Disian. I just picked it up after listening to them for years. Don't believe me? Go ahead, touch them and see for yourself.
It truly is a peculiar pair of blades, one that sends shivers down the spine if stared at too long. Yet Sibilla can't help but reach out her hand...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Just kidding! Don't touch it.

The woman whisks the blades away with a giggle. She often speaks in riddles like this. It is hard to tell if this stems from cultural differences between city-states, the peculiar wiring of her mind, or perhaps...
Sibilla doesn't want to entertain the notion, but Jasmine's power seems to be having a negative effect on her.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Good people like you shouldn't dirty those hands with weapons. You're going there for the celebration, so keep that joy simple and clean. Let me handle the sharp things.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Then what about you, Jasmine? Where do you come from?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Hmm... I don't remember.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I see. Then why do you want to go to DisCity?

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I don't remember.
Jasmine's gaze flickers away for a fleeting moment.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I guess the blades want me to go. Yeah, simple as that. And I can protect you along the way. Perfect, right? Alright, that's enough chatter.
She rises to her feet, her expression alert, yet her eyes light up with an eerie spark.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Something's coming. Tuck yourself away nice and tight. And no peeking.

steps.speaker: Shadow Behemoth
steps.content: Hiss... Hisssssss...
With a deafening roar, a colossal sandworm bursts forth from the sand.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Just a worm? And here I was, thinking my moment had finally come.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: A sandworm? How did it find us? And why is it so agitated...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Oh! I just remembered. While you were snoozing, I went to fetch water and stumbled on a nest of worm eggs. Since you are not a fan of blood, I thought I'd change things up. Just give these worm babies a squeeze, and they make a pretty tasty drink, you know.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...That's even worse than blood!
